en: Black‑and‑white image showing the interior of a ruined stone and brick church whose roof has collapsed, leaving high Gothic arches and broken window tracery. The floor of the ruined nave is densely filled with graves and headstones, many with crosses and floral plots, forming a churchyard cemetery within the old walls. At the far end is an apse-like wall niche with a large crucifix and other religious monuments. Outside the broken window on the right a tall industrial chimney is visible on the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or text typical of a modern postcard front.
